topics.topic: Trump's new task force to fight fraud
topics.description: Trump's new task force to fight fraud is a significant development in the effort to root out fraud in federal benefits programs. The task force will be led by JD Vance and will focus on identifying and preventing fraud in programs such as Medicaid and food stamps.
